articles.title: Unlocking Lossless Speedups in LLMs via Discrete Diffusion
articles.excerpt: Large Language Models (LLMs) owe much of their success to next-token prediction (NTP), but their autoregressive (AR) structure requires slow, sequential token generation. articles.title: FlowBalance: Verifier-Grounded Self-Improvement from On-Policy Reasoning Experience

articles.title: The Attention Triangle in Audio-Video Models

articles.title: DriveZero: End-to-End Driving Beyond Human Demonstrations
